Ina is making dinner for her friend Miguel Florres-Vianna who is out at the barn photographing the garden. While Miguel takes photos he creates a surprise table setting for Ina inspired by foliage found in the garden. On the menu are Panko crusted salmon, warm French lentils, all American cheeseboard and chicken noodle soup for Miguel's journey back to the city.

It's a drill dinner for local firefighters. After a practice fire drill, Ina pitches in and serves the firefighters up a delicious dinner back at the station. There's Beef Barley Soup, Firefighter Scott Elley's Sloppy Joes served with Ina's Stilton Dressing and make-your-own Pecan Caramel Sundaes.

It's competition time and battle of the taste buds as Ina and her friends Eli Zabar and David Ziff plan a pot luck dinner. They each take a course with a Mediterranean theme. But first there's breakfast at Ina's to discuss the plan over delicious tri-berry pancakes.

It's a pre-party tasting and planning meeting for the son of Ina's friend's rehearsal dinner. There's tarragon potato salad, chunky blue cheese dressing, vegetable coleslaw and guacamole to pair up with local takeaway specialties.

Ina's making over classic dishes and turning up the volume with new ingredients and cooking methods. By daring to be different Ina transforms dishes with a big flavour payoff. There's Easy parmesan risotto, deconstructed strawberry shortcakes and a new take on breakfast, Eggs Columbian, a favourite at local cafe and speciality food store Mary's Marvellous.

This is all about comfort food as Ina cooks up modern day comfort classics. Helping her is New York caterer Mary Giuliani, famous for her miniature grilled cheese sandwich canapés plus there's French toast bread pudding and Seafood pot pie. This is comfort for breakfast, dinner and entertaining.
Jamie Oliver tantalises the taste buds with sesame and miso salmon, no-cook pasta sauce, a gnarly lamb madras traybake, no-fuss fish cakes and a hot and crispy ice cream parcel.

In St Emilion James visits the kitchens where he worked as a lad more than 30 years ago.

Mary Berry shows how to host a traditional tea party without any fuss. She shares a clever trick for making sandwiches in advance, bakes bite-sized scones for a cream tea, and her granddaughters help her to make orange butterfly cakes.

Mary shows how to cook dishes to impress guests at a dinner party without getting hot and bothered in the kitchen, including two delicious canapés, a salmon and asparagus starter, a main course of guinea fowl and a decadent chocolate tart.

Mary cooks for a relaxed and informal family get-together, with dishes including a slow-roast shoulder of lamb with rosemary and paprika rub, potato and fennel gratin, plum tarte tatin and delicious fruit salad.

Mary Berry is cooking dishes for a family celebration. She makes it seem almost effortless, with recipes for beef and mushroom stew with mustard mash, salmon en croûte with a foolproof salad, and chocolate and orange panna cotta.

Mary Berry is throwing a casual weekday supper. Her Mediterranean platter of hummus, bread sticks, roasted vegetables and a tomato and mozzarella salad is perfect food for sharing on a summer's evening.

For Mary's outdoor party the dishes are best served cold. These include salmon fillets with herb sauce, ham with homemade chutney and fillet of beef with garlic and mustard cream. To accompany the cold meats and fish there are two salads.

Soothing and much-loved home comfort delights, from the very simple to the extremely decadent. Mary indulges her love of comfort food with homely recipes to warm the heart including Eggs Benedict Florentine, fall-off-the-bone slow-cooked lamb shanks and deliciously rich chocolate truffle pots. She invites Swedish fire-chef Niklas Esktedt to share the joys of cave-man cooking with her, and enjoys his inventive venison meatballs with blackened celeriac and mouth-watering Swedish donuts.

Mary returns to school to celebrate her light, easy and delicious cooking. From a simple version of the classic kedgeree and some delightful breakfast drop scones, to a moreish chicken, avocado and bacon salad and deliciously easy beef burgers. Mary takes her inspiration from a visit to a groundbreaking primary school in south London which has built a secret garden where they teach their students how to grow vegetables and look after a brood of chickens.

Mary embraces the British countryside with fresh and honest bucolic cooking inspired by what is grown on farms and in gardens, from joyous pasta inspired by a classic French herb sauce, to a perfect way to partner asparagus, and how to serve up the most scrumptious roasted vegetables. Mary makes her way through vegetable rows and orchards, ending with her own inspired version of the delicious tarte tatin.

Mary has always adored entertaining and pulls out some of her finest classics that will leave any guest begging for the next invitation, be it a romantic meal for two or hosting a big meal for friends and family. From her divine Dover sole cooked to perfection, a genius way to make beetroot gravadlax and a sticky chicken recipe that will have them knocking down the doors, to an ambitious crispy roast duck and a simple but exquisite raspberry mousse.

Leigh from Kent is looking for a holiday home on Tenerife, and she's brought along her nephew Sammy to help her. With a maximum budget of £300,000, property expert Jasmine Harman has been tasked with finding her the perfect place.

Tracey and Fran have been best friends since their schooldays, and they've now decided to club together to buy a holiday home on the east coast of Fuerteventura. Danni Menzies shows them five options for their budget of £250,000.
Horse lovers Mel and James want a holiday home in Mijas Pueblo in southern Spain. Laura Hamilton shows them the best of what their £180,000 budget can get them with five impressive properties.

Ben Hillman jets off to Spain's southern Costa Cálida to help Joan and Andrew find their dream holiday home. They want a property the whole family can enjoy. With a budget of £80,000 to spend, Ben shows them five fantastic properties.

In Inverness, first to host is proud Scot and National Heritage worker Gillian Sutherland. Gillian's dinner party is a true Scottish affair, and she's hoping her 'Touch of Tartan' theme will win over her guests.
It's night two of the competition in Inverness, where designer label fanatic Melissa Kirby has given herself a sneaky advantage.

In Inverness, property tycoon David Edes hosts a nautical evening. David is a teetotaller and plans a menu of 'basic but wholesome food' making his guests wary. A night of suspicion and hilarity ensues.
Rock 'n' roll hairdresser Zarina Ainslie is the latest to host in Inverness. The tattooed party girl claims to be an amazing cook. Perhaps she could be the dark horse of the competition.
It's the final night in Inverness and ex-professional footballer Jamie Tulloch has gone to town making sure his ingredients are all as fresh and local as possible.

The first visit of the week is to Derwent House Apartments in Scarborough, North Yorkshire, run by Claire and her daughter-in-law, Jessica. The pair are planning to wow their guests with some self-catered luxury on the seaside.

Visit two is to Burton Constable Holiday Park in Sproatley near Hull, run by park wardens Gemma and Mark. The lodges are a big hit initially, but a nasty surprise leaves a fly in the ointment for Claire and Jessica.
Professional chef Stephen hosts the week's third visit at The Crossings Inn in Cumbria. His ethos is no-nonsense accommodation and gorgeous grub, leaving expectations sky-high at breakfast time.

The week's last visit is to Jane's lovingly restored Plas Maenan Country House in Wales' Conwy Valley. However, it seems Jane's restoration work doesn't meet everyone's standards, as some guests bemoan the patchy paintwork.

It's payment day, and emotions are running high as the B&Bers pore over their feedback. The guests agree on some things, disagree on more, and debate their differences before the payments are revealed, and the winner is announced.

Eighty-eight-year-old Hasuben is rushed in having been found collapsed and unresponsive at home. Law student Jamie has a condition called pectus excavatum, which causes his ribs to grow in an inward direction. A 23-year-old bartender and dad-to-be called Robert is in A&E after a beer barrel fell on his leg.
A 14-year-old is rushed in after falling head first off her bike, a 56-year-old man can't breathe due to an ear infection and a plasterer has had a serious accident at work.

Dr Caitlin and Dr Michael fear a motorbike rider might lose his foot after a shocking crash. Dr Laura and Dr Mark bend over backwards to help a woman with a dislocated hip. Dr Emma examines a young man who is comfortably numb.

A surfer has a heart attack while out in the water, and Dr Caitlin and Dr Martin are not sure if they can save him. Dr Mya helps a mum with agonising leg injuries after she was squashed between a motorbike and 4WD.
A consultant sent to acquire a local brewery falls for its crafty owner, then fights to save it from corporate takeover.
A guardian angel shows a disillusioned war veteran that his life makes a difference.
After a snowstorm prevents all the presents from being delivered to base, two rival marines must team up for a special mission to save Christmas.
A teacher's quiet holiday season gets a jolt of spice when she accepts 12 dares of Christmas challenge from her sister.
Two best friends crash Christmas parties and unexpectedly find love and purpose.
During a blizzard at Christmas time, a man becomes snowbound with his ex-wife, her wealthy suitor, his former mother-in-law and his daughter.
A loving couple shares the story of how they met and fell in love when their daughter's boyfriend comes to meet them for the first time at Christmas.

In 1951, a wartime doctor tries to make Christmas special for his worried wife. In 2003, a newly married couple host two sets of in-laws for Christmas Eve. In 2024, a couple try to arrange special holiday surprises for each other.
With no other plans for Christmas, best friends Bea and Emilia travel to Christmasland, a magical place filled with hope, holiday miracles and romance.
Overwhelmed by her royal duties, Princess Victoria visits Big Sky Country for Christmas and meets her dashing guide at the ranch. She must decide if love is worth leaving her royal life behind.
A New York City book editor takes on a temporary gig running a Maine bookshop for the month of December. While battling with the owners' son, she rediscovers her passion for nurturing creativity.
With Holly away, Chloe and Charlotte's friendship goes next level. Chantelle's plan to test Scott goes badly wrong and Chloe is quick to take advantage.
The final six artists must complete two challenges to place in the top four; they are awakened by a blind judging and are left shocked after an emotional elimination.
The top four artists have to get a final tattoo; one artist wins $250,000 and the title of Ink Master.
Katie gets her Ex-Tra Power which could spell the end of the road for one of the originals, George questions Bayley's trustworthiness and a new ex threatens all the couples' loyalties.
Daria's competing for an academic award. Will she be forced to show enthusiasm?
Leah and Corey battle in court over custody of the twins. Jenelle agrees to let Nathan see Kaiser and David volunteers to be their contact person. Kail struggles to help Isaac while he misses Javi.

Judy gets tough at rehearsal, and the candidates learn how to carry themselves under pressure at etiquette training. The first show group performance of the year gets underway, and the ladies must shine in front of Charlotte and Mr Jones.

The final rehearsal: to cut or not to cut, that is the question. Dreams come true as the squad photo is taken. The ladies hit the field for their first game, but first they must prove the moment isn't too big for them.
Four hundred dancers from all over the country converge on AT&T Stadium to start the hardest audition process in the entertainment business to become a Dallas Cowboys cheerleader.

Mackenzie, Khesanio, and the kids travel to Oklahoma to surprise her family with the announcement she's pregnant with twins; Ashley moves into a new home to escape memories of her past; Ryan proposes to Amanda with Bentley's help.

Maci, Cate, Tyler, Leah, and Gary reunite in NYC with their teenagers to celebrate 16 years of Teen Mom. Cate finds her place without Carly. Leah Shirley speaks up about her relationship with Amber. Back home, Amber works through trauma with her mum.

Maci and Bentley meet Ryan's new daughter, Presley. Cate and Tyler seek Dr Drew's guidance. Cheyenne and Zach see a relationship coach as they navigate fertility issues. Briana has the sex talk with Nova and gives her a baby simulator.
When Paige accidentally switches bodies with Phoebe, the sisters are forced to battle a Zen master's evil disciple while struggling to harness each other's powers.

Paige finds her knight in shining armour when a beloved fairytale comes true, but she must also contend with an evil incarnation of herself from a past life as a medieval enchantress. Meanwhile, Phoebe and Piper travel back in time to the Dark Ages.
Phoebe and Paige must prevent a deluded Piper from giving up their powers after The Source taps into her brain and lands her in a mental institution.

While mulling over his marriage proposal, Phoebe comes face-to-face with proof of Cole's demonic past in the shape of a vengeful widow. Meanwhile, Paige encourages Piper and Leo to test out their parenting skills.
Phoebe, Paige and Piper go up against warlocks who are using muses for evil purposes, and an insecure Cole loses his cool when Phoebe turns down his marriage proposal.
Lucille led a simple life until she was asked to work for music producer Kidd Cole. Companies were never paid, and one day Kidd couldn't be found. She searches for some answers.
Keyonnah can hardly believe her luck, as she's almost certain that she's been having an online relationship with her childhood crush, the rapper Bow Wow.
After chatting for years with Chris, Shakinah needs to move forward with her life. But when Nev and co-host Kamie Crawford find out that Chris is a pop star, they know Shakinah needs help.
Dr Emma McMullen operates on a strange pectoral lipoma. 43-year-old Tamzin comes to see Dr Natalia Spierings who's a specialist in her skin condition melasma.

The parlour gets a visit from Stephen, who now, as a respectable dad, wants to give the finger to a very crude tattoo he had done 20 years ago. Alice welcomes Rob, a tattoo-mad ex-solider whose mum thinks his phallic self-portrait is a step too far.

Steve, survivor of a horrific house fire, wants to cover his scarring with a special Celtic knot design. Danny, whose portrait of Tupac ended in disaster, is helped out by both Sketch and Jay as he gets a brand-new portrait of the late rapper.

Visitors to the studio include Georgie, who commemorated her trip with the boys with a tattoo that's left her single ever since. Alice takes on Kelly's animation-inspired disaster, while Sketch deals with rugby lad Connor's freaky foot.
A 2,000-year-old warrior emerges from the earth, clues point to a portal to the underworld and satellites track a monstrous bog creature.
When satellites capture a strange oozing grey mass in the Mississippi countryside, scientist Nick Pollock goes to investigate.
A mysterious opening on the Red Planet caught on camera, a UFO appears to invade an Amazon village, and an unidentified spacecraft disrupts the queen's jubilee celebrations in London in June 2022.
Experts unseal the truth about the potential aliens living and working among us.
In 1980, a UFO detected on military radar, landed near crucial NATO bases. A group of military personnel claim to have seen a shiny metallic object with coloured lights and hieroglyphic inscriptions.
An abandoned city in remote jungles could be the home of an ancient treasure. Also, could a mysterious stone circle be the fabled round table of King Arthur?
The US military is investigating whether conflicts could be fought through mind control and a boy who lost his thumb in a horrific accident uses a mysterious powder to regrow it.

An eerie shape appears over Chicago. A man is fighting for his life after being shot by an unknown object, and a US military fighter jet appears to be being pursued by a UFO over the Bermuda Triangle.
A fleet of potential UFOs are filmed over the South China Sea, they seem to be appearing and disappearing, Plus, a 12,000-year-old archaeological site features carvings of extraterrestrial humanoids.

John Lennon and May Pang claimed to have seen a UFO from their balcony in New York, and a sinister visitor to a remote nuclear missile launch site in Montana, which more than 40 years ago caused nuclear missiles to be disabled for 24 hours.
A UFO is recorded flying straight from the sky into the sea with no loss of speed. Plus, astronaut Neil Armstrong goes in search of an ancient extraterrestrial library in the Ecuadorian jungle.

Several UFOs suddenly appear above Swedish power plants and other places. Some believe that the country will soon be the target of an attack. A soldier claims to have encountered a UFO years ago and receives compensation from the US military.

A fleet of UFOs is filmed over the South China Sea, a 12,000-year-old archaeological site reveals carvings of alien, six-fingered humanoids, and a recorded confession claims that Albert Einstein made a secret visit to Roswell in 1947 to see a crashed UFO and its dead and dying occupants.
A man in Missouri films what looks like a metal cube spinning in the sky. Something very similar is seen in LA, Texas and Columbia.
A US navy warship is orbited by UFOs. Meanwhile, a British TV programme is interrupted by a voice claiming to be from the Ashtar Galactic Command, warning that Earth is in danger.

A UFO is caught on camera by a military helicopter on the Mexican border, an English woman is filmed disappearing from her bed at night, and NASA investigates UFOs after years of denial by the US authorities.

Die Dokumentation zeigt antike Bauwerke. Als die Griechen die Perser besiegt hatten, bauten sie die Akropolis wieder auf und errichteten den Parthenon. In der Mitte des Säulentempels stand eine riesige Statue der Göttin Athene.

Die Polarwirbel sind besonders gefährlich für den Menschen. Sie sind eiskalt und tatsächlich kälter gemessen als die Temperaturen auf dem Mars. Die Temperaturen würden einen Menschen in Sekundenschnelle erfrieren, sodass ein Überleben unmöglich ist.

2010 bis 2019 war die bis dato heißeste Dekade seit Beginn der Wetteraufzeichnungen vor 140 Jahren. Im Juli 2018 wurden weltweit neue Temperaturrekorde aufgestellt und das Death Valley erlebte den heißesten Monat, der je auf der Erde gemessen wurde. Doch woher rühren immer extremere Hitzeperioden? Sind sie menschengemacht? Experte Dr. Michael Mann klärt über den Zusammenhang zwischen den lebensbedrohlichen Hitzewellen und dem Klimawandel auf.

Überschwemmungen sind kaum bis gar nicht aufzuhalten und haben unterschiedliche Ursachen. Durch Starkregen, übertretende Flüsse oder das Versagen beim Eindämmen von Wassermassen kommt es immer wieder zu großen Katastrophen.

Aufgrund von tektonischen Plattenverschiebungen kommt es immer wieder zu schlimmen Erdbeben in verschiedenen Regionen der Erde. Dabei treten immer wieder hohe Todeszahlen auf. Außerdem werden viele Menschen durch die Zerstörung obdachlos.

Berichtet wird über aktuelle Themen des Tages und die wichtigsten Entwicklungen in der Welt. Zudem werden Hintergründe und Einschätzungen von Politikern und Experten geliefert und es wird zusammengefasst, was die Menschen bewegt.

Beleuchtet werden Themen aus aller Welt und es Menschen und Geschichten hinter den Schlagzeilen aus der ganzen Welt gezeigt. Berichtet wird über beispielsweise über Atomversuche, Flüchtlinge und viele weitere Ereignisse rund um den Globus.

Nicht ohne meine alte Nummer - unkompliziert Handytarif wechseln und Geld sparen / Immer das passende Schnittwerkzeug zur Hand - Messerblöcke im Test / Sauberer Herd - mit diesen praktischen Tipps entfernen Sie auch den hartnäckigsten Schmutz.

Start-ups gewinnen als wichtiger Impulsgeber für Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft zunehmend an Bedeutung. Dieses Magazin widmet sich in jeder Ausgabe jeweils einem Thema, das Janna Linke gemeinsam mit einem Experten von verschiedenen Seiten beleuchtet.

Ohne Piks zum Wohlfühlgewicht - das sollte bei der Abnehmpille beachtet werden / Deutschlands beliebtester Fisch - worauf Sie beim Lachskauf unbedingt achten sollten / Welche Überwachungskameras für den Einbruchschutz am besten geeignet sind.

Bei Streamingdiensten kennt man es oder vom Smartphone - Abos für Appdienste. Wird das Auto jetzt auch zur Abofalle? Dazu zwei Fahrtests: Skoda Peaq - das größte Elektroauto, das Skoda jemals gebaut hat und BMW 3er-Verbrenner.
Wie funktioniert der größte Kreuzfahrthafen der Welt, wie hat sich ein Skiort in den letzten zehn Jahren unter den Eindrücken von Corona, Energiekrisen und Klimawandel verändert?

Um sich selbst zu verteidigen und Futter zu fangen, verfügen einige Tiere über tödliche Gifte. Darunter befinden sich Schlangen, Spinnen und einige andere Tiere. Darunter sind auch die Sydney Funnel Web Spider und die Eastern Diamondback Rattlesnake.
Von einem Erdwallsystem der indigenen Völker Nordamerikas bis hin zu einem rosafarbenen Leuchten im Pazifik - was am Boden bislang verborgen geblieben ist, wird dank Luftaufnahmen endlich sichtbar.
Mysteriöse Bauwerke auf einer italienischen und einer japanischen Insel deuten auf eine dunkle Vergangenheit hin. Außerdem taucht in einer indonesischen Höhle ein merkwürdiger Schädel auf.

Auf Beacon Island in Australien wird ein Skelett ohne Kopf entdeckt. Bei den Marshallinseln im Pazifik wird ein riesiger Unterwasserkrater untersucht. In einem Grab auf einer Insel im Ärmelkanal werden seltsame Tierknochen gefunden.

Die Beamten nehmen am El-Dorado-Flughafen einen Zahnarztstuhl in den Blick und entdecken etwas durchaus Außergewöhnliches. Gleichzeitig belastet ein Mann, der mit Kokain in der Tasche aufgegriffen wird, seine Frau schwer.

Forscher versuchen, das Rätsel einer Kraterlandschaft, im Osten Englands, vermutlich aus dem Steinzeitalter, zu lösen. Darunter befinden sich Schächte und Stollen, in denen prähistorische Bergarbeiter Feuerstein ausgegraben haben.

Bei den Steinbauten in der Wüste des Irans handelt es sich um Zeugnisse einer alten Religion. Anhänger des Zoroastrismus überließen ihre Toten den Aasgeiern, um das heilige Element Erde nicht mit den unreinen Überresten der Verstorbenen zu entweihen.

Im zweiten Teil der Dokumentation werden die Top 10 der skurrilsten Dashcam-Aufnahmen gekürt. Darüber hinaus wird auch gezeigt, welche Naturereignisse, wie ein Tornado oder Aquaplaning, dem Autofahrer zum Verhängnis werden können.

Ein Mann, der von einem mexikanischen Drogenkartell entführt wurde, sprintet über die Grenze nach Amerika. An der Progreso International Bridge an der Grenze zu Mexiko wird eine Frau dabei erwischt, wie sie Beruhigungspillen versteckt.
Ein gekidnappter Mann von einem Drogenkartell flieht über die Brücke in die USA.
Eine Familie aus Venezuela will in die USA reisen, doch drei von ihnen haben kein gültiges Visum.
In einem Fahrzeug an der World Trade Bridge werden hunderte Kartons voller Drogen gefunden.

Die Sendung besucht die Ruinen einer früheren Industriestadt in den Vereinigten Staaten und eine schottische Insel im Atlantik. Außerdem führt der Weg zu den Gedenkstätten eines großen Feuers im japanischen Kobe.

Eine Sanatorium in den USA, das wegen einer Pandemie errichtet wurde, ein unterirdisches Labyrinth, in dem ein schrecklicher Mord stattfand, ein in die Klippe geschlagenes Meisterwerk und ein Leuchtfeuer, das eine der berüchtigtsten Botschaften der amerikanischen Geschichte zeigt. Diese verlassenen Orte sind heruntergekommen durch Naturkatastrophen und kriegerische Auseinandersetzungen. Die Ruinen zeugen von Tod und Zerstörung, aber auch von menschlichem Einfallsreichtum und Fortschritt.

In dieser Folge der Sendung wird eine Schlucht in der amerikanischen Wüste erforscht, in der Reichtum angehäuft wurde und viele Menschen ihr Leben verloren. Außerdem gibt es einen Blick in eine schottische Inselfestung mit einer Schwachstelle.

In dieser Folge der Sendung diskutieren Experten über den Ursprung eines mysteriösen Bauwerks auf einer kleinen Gezeiteninsel in Wales. Außerdem enthüllen alte Bücher das Geheimnis eines verlassenen Gebäudes in Kroatien.

Es wird ein Blick hinter die Kulissen der Massenherstellung von Backwaren geworfen. Denn ohne die Großproduktion von Backwaren ist der Bedarf heutzutage nicht mehr zu decken, egal ob es sich um Torten, Küchlein oder tägliche Brötchen handelt.

In kaum einem europäischen Land leben so viele Veganer wie in Deutschland. Dennoch ist die Auswahl an Fleisch- und Wurstprodukten hierzulande vielfältig. Wie essen die Deutschen und woher kommt unsere Lust auf Fleisch? Diese Reportage geht dieser Frage auf den Grund und möchte gemeinsam mit Ernährungssoziologen, Vertretern der Fleischwirtschaft sowie der vegetarisch-veganen Lebensweise Wege finden, wie beide gemeinsam an den Tisch kommen können.

Deutschland ist weltweit bekannt als die Biernation schlechthin. Daher ist auch das Angebot an den verschiedenen Getränkesorten entsprechend groß. Dennoch entstehen laufend neue Brauereien, sogenannte Mikrobrauereien. An den Grundzutaten wird zwar festgehalten, doch die Variationen und Zutaten sind vielfältig. Ein Blick hinter die Entstehungsgeschichte eines Bieres gibt Aufschluss über Zusammensetzung und Produktionsabläufe des beliebten Gerstensaftes.

Wenn es draußen dunkel wird, beginnt für den Großmarkt Hamburg der Tag. Das größte Frischezentrum Norddeutschlands gewährt einen spannenden Einblick hinter die Kulissen eines penibel durchorganisierten und international vernetzten Großmarktes.

Die "Maartje Theodora" ist das Schwergewicht der deutschen Hochseefischereiflotte. Rund 6.000 Tonnen Frischfisch kann das Schiff verarbeiten und transportieren. In der Fabrik unter Deck wird der Fang direkt sortiert und gefroren.

MTU (Motoren- und Turbinen-Union Friedrichshafen) ist eine Marke der Rolls-Royce Power Systems. Ihre Antriebssysteme und Großdieselmotoren heizen beispielsweise Schiffen, Schwer- und Militärfahrzeugen oder Eisenbahnen ordentlich ein.

Die Reportage begleitet Verbrenner-Fans und ihre teilweise ausgefallenen Exemplare. Experten wie Peter Pfeffer, Professor für Fahrzeugtechnik, sprechen außerdem über die Gegenwart und die Zukunft der Autonation Deutschland.

Der Porsche 911 ist einer der bekanntesten und elegantesten Sportwagen aller Zeiten. Die neue Variante besitzt 400 PS und kostet mehr als 200.000 Euro. Der Rennsportler Hans-Joachim Stuck schaut sich das Auto genauer an.

Es wird ein Blick hinter die Kulissen der größten Waschstraße der Welt in Stuttgart geworfen. Bis zu 4.000 Autowäschen und rund tausend Innenreinigungen nimmt der Familienbetrieb an einem Tag vor. Dafür ist ein enormer logistischer Aufwand nötig.
Der Zoll findet eine große Menge Zigaretten und ein liebeskranker Litauer bittet um Nachsicht.

Ein nigerianischer Staatsbürger wird mit Grenzschutzbeamten konfrontiert. Der Zoll findet ein äußerst verdächtiges Paket aus Afrika. Währenddessen spricht die Einwanderungsbehörde mit einem DJ, der versucht, ohne Visum zu arbeiten.

In dieser Folge versucht ein britischer Staatsbürger, sein Land zu verlassen. Außerdem trifft im Postzentrum ein mysteriöses Paket ein und Beamte vom Zoll und Polizei sind auf der Suche nach einem Boot in der Bay of Islands.

In dieser Folge entdecken die Beamten eine lebende Katze im Handgepäck einer Touristin. Außerdem wird ein unscheinbares Plüschtier als Drogenversteck entlarvt und die Einsatzkräfte müssen zwei Einheimische auf dem Wasser wieder zur Vernunft bringen.

Der größte Wasserthemenpark seiner Art im Mittleren Osten ist das Aquaventure in Dubai. Er ist jüngst um ein weiteres 5,5 Hektar großes Paradies an Baderutschen sowie einen Parkteil mit einem 34 Meter hohen Rutschenturm erweitert worden.

Im Allgäu wird auf einer Fläche von 184 Hektar ein gigantischer Ferienpark errichtet. In tausend Ferienhäusern sollen zukünftig rund 5.000 Gäste ihren Urlaub verbringen können. Doch bis zur Eröffnung der Anlage ist es noch ein weiter Weg.

Der ehemalige Achterbahn-Testpark in Rust zieht täglich bis zu 30.000 Gäste an. Für einen reibungslosen Ablauf und ein unvergessliches Erlebnis sorgt ein engagiertes Team aus Technikern, Reinigungskräften und Gastronomen im Hintergrund.
Gezeigt wird eine Manöverfahrt auf dem modernsten U-Boot Deutschlands, dem U-36.

Jedes Jahr beschafft die Bundeswehr für Milliarden Euro neue Ausrüstung. Doch bevor sie es zur Truppe schafft, muss sie beweisen, dass sie schlagkräftig und sicher ist. Verantwortlich dafür ist das Bundesamt für Ausrüstung.

Die Dokumentation zeigt einen Einblick in das Waffenarsenal der Bundeswehr. Dort finden sich hochmoderne Waffensysteme, die sich für eine Vielzahl von Einsätzen eignen, von Kämpfen gegen Terrororganisationen bis hin zum Schutz von Feldlagern.

Es wird die Produktion des Kettenfahrzeugs Lynx in Unterlüß und Ungarn begleitet. Ausgestattet mit dem Lance-Turm und modernster Hightech, erkennt er feindliche Angriffe und reagiert mit automatischer Zielverfolgung.

Militärhubschrauber sind unverzichtbar für die Bundeswehr. Sie dienen vielfältigen Zwecken wie Transport, Kampf und Rettung bei Land-, See- und Lufteinsätzen. Ihre Zuverlässigkeit und Schnelligkeit sind unter allen Bedingungen entscheidend.

Diese Sendung berichtet über den Apache-Kampfhubschrauber, der auch Guardian genannt ist. Das neuste Modell AH-64 E wird mit stärkeren Motoren als in der Vergangenheit ausgestattet und ist damit schneller und wendiger als sein Vorgängermodell.
Up against countless obstacles, rural Alaskans must work hard to survive.
Refurbishing experts Jay, Dan, and Mark head to historic Philadelphia to explore an abandoned gothic church and school.
The guys head to Colorado Springs, where Jim discovers one of the biggest items ever considered for an auction: a WWII aircraft searchlight.
Hunting for collectibles, Shooter tests a WWI bar rifle at the range while Sean evaluates two over-under guns that appear to have no trigger.
How does a team of chefs prepare meals and snacks from scratch for childcare centres in the Toronto area? Plus, how does a bakery deal with a large order of carrot cakes?
How will a mobile taco van fare at a food truck competition? Meanwhile, can a bakery be able to produce a bespoke desert for a ladies golf tournament?

In the wild, attracting a mate and getting the chance to breed is like a blood sport. The mating urge drives animals to make long journeys, to let down their guard in the presence of predators and fight each other to the death.
A deadly predator is stalking the forests of Costa Rica. It is a super organism made up of half a million tiny individuals, an army ant colony.

With Brazil's Chapecoense soccer team on board, LaMia Flight 2933 is on its final approach to Medellín, Colombia when the crew suddenly declares a fuel emergency. Before air traffic control even has time to clear a path, the plane crashes.
United Express Flight 6291 is on its approach when the high-performance twin turboprop crashes.

The Hawker Harrier flies as fast as a jet and hovers like a helicopter. Uncover the groundbreaking technology behind this unique ability and how the Harrier became crucial for Britain in the Falklands War.
Explore a never-before-seen world hidden under miles of water. Join expeditions to recover long-lost vessels, check out ancient sites and follow scientists probing the deepest corners of the seabed.
Tim Maltin explores unheard evidence and overlooked details to reveal the main reason why the Titanic sank with a simple trick of light.
A team of elite technical divers searches the remote waters of the Great Lakes for lost ships of the past.
Africa is an extraordinary continent, shaping the wildlife that call it HOME.
Welcome to Africa. We take you deep into the heart of our wildest continent, bringing you closer to its animals, landscapes and the people watching over it than ever before.
Africa's paradise islands are home to the strangest creatures on Earth.
Only the most determined animals can survive the largest desert in Africa.
On 12 April 1990, Widerøe Flight 839 crashed into the water shortly after takeoff from Værøy Airport in Norway, killing all five people on board.
Bound for Kathmandu, Thai Airways Flight 311 crashed into the Himalayas, far from where it was supposed to be.

The crash of a Korean cargo plane outside London baffled investigators. Though they quickly determined the cause of the disaster, it's possible the first officer was more concerned with saving face rather than preventing the disaster from happening.

Ireland doesn't take up much room on the map, but few places have an identity so celebrated across the world. Hannah Fry journeys to her ancestral homeland to discover what it means to be Irish. She traces her Irish DNA.
Traces how Devereux transformed from Queen Elizabeth I's ultimate "golden boy" and charismatic war hero during the Spanish Armada into a desperate traitor.
After the landing on Normandy Beach, the Battle of Carentan broke out and an American unit launched a desperate bayonet charge.

The Dawson City Fire Department races to protect the town from devastating flash floods. Officers track down a dangerous and destructive bison herd, have a run-in with a bear and set up a sting to catch a suspected serial over-fisher.
A large black mamba hides inside a TV, a nun is on the run from a spitting cobra and a baby python is stuck inside an air-con unit.
With emergency farm calls and clinic visits done for the week, the Pols celebrate the Fourth of July with a parade, barbecue and fireworks.
Dr Oakley treats a dangerously thin reindeer with a bellyache.
In harsh climates, the land becomes a survival resource for Alaska Natives.

The boto dolphin and the giant otter are some of the inhabitants of lagoons and flooded forests. In this world, the Amazon rushes then recedes as the rainforest's terrestrial and aquatic realms battle for dominance.
Revealing a new world teeming with predators. Stealthy jaguars prowl, army ants swarm and tarantulas bring down rodent prey as 2.5 million square miles of rainforest emerge from the folds.

The world's greatest rainforest is home to nearly half the world's species. Life-and-death dramas unfold in this most precarious of habitats, more than 100 feet above the forest floor, as Harpy eagles carry off full-grown monkeys.
A horse with a mysterious brain injury; a potbelly pig misses her flu shot; Dr. Pol and the clinic encounter a shocking set of cases.
The cold and weary team experiences the harshness of winter.

The youngsters visit the zoo where they are shown around by zookeepers Mr Lion, Mrs Crocodile and Mr Giraffe.
Peppa and her family are on holiday in Australia. They are visiting the Kangaroo family, who take them to explore the outback on their first day.
The Kangaroos take Peppa and her family to the beach on their second day in Australia where they try surfing for the first time.
Mrs Kangaroo takes everyone on an amazing adventure under the sea in her submarine to see the Great Barrier Reef.

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.
Kana wants to go extra fast, but Sodor's tracks are too twisty. To help, the engines lay some straight tracks that accidentally lead to a watery place.

Paddington attempts to deliver a hot lunch after learning that seagulls love chips and will do anything to get them. On a foggy night, the lighthouse light breaks and Paddington must help save a boat at sea.
Paddington leads a treasure hunt to find Captain Green Beard's loot. Everyone is keen to win the sandcastle competition and enjoy a special ice cream prize, but teamwork is the key to success.

Paddington and the Browns rescue pufflings, who get lost around the campsite instead of taking their first flight. Paddington enjoys a diving adventure with Jonathan and Judy - but where is her necklace?

The beach is a mess, but all the litter must be cleared up in time for the beach party that everyone has been looking forward to. As the summer holidays come to an end, the time arrives to say goodbye to new friends.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Mayor Humdinger has been carving his face into the cliffs of Adventure Bay.
Carlos and Tracker make pawpaw juice with the PAW Patrol when they find out Mayor Goodway and Chickaletta are in trouble.
Paddington seeks the mystery hero doing good deeds, Paddington gets stuck in an igloo.

Paddington tries to find out who his favourite hero is, so he sets out with Judy. Paddington really wants to participate in a skating competition, but he can't. Until Mateo gives him a helping hand with a magical mask.

Paddington has a race against time in order to enjoy his first ever solar eclipse. Paddington accepts an inventor's award for Simi when she's too shy to step up, but it makes Simi feel jealous and sad.
Join Tim Rex, brother Tommy, sister Tia, and Triceratops bestie Kai as they tackle kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions! Tim, Tommy, Tia and Dad get stuck on a remote asteroid.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim, Kai and Tommy try to get their ball back from Mum's bedroom.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tia's new balloon gets stuck in a tree, so Tim tries to get it down.
Holly and her friends must stay in the courtyard and play with Holly's little twin sisters Daisy and Poppy. All is fine until the twins borrow a magic wand and escape from the castle.
Three baby ladybirds, Amber, Emerald and Keith have come to stay at Uncle Gaston's for the day. The baby ladybirds are exhausting! So Ben and Holly help Gaston to keep them entertained.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.

When a windstorm sends a polar bear cub down to Adventure Bay, it's up to Ryder, Everest, and the pups to bring the baby bear back to its family; the Pups must save Mayor Humdinger from a runaway movie projector.
Arrby recruits a crew of meerkats to gather magical seeds. Mayor Humdinger wants a hippo as his new hench-animal, but needs a rescue when it gallops off with Humdinger on its back.
Transformed into a fox, Annette gets a new perspective on the animals in her care.

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
The Marsupilamis are great at making music, and when a music producer hears it Jade says it was her. Lalou's cat adoption day doesn't go smoothly, when Punch is adopted by mistake.
Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play, and build whatever the community needs.
When Tim finds Blobert, an old toy, it brings out the monster in him.
Tim, Tommy and Tia do all they can to stop Grandma leaving, so they can spend more time with her.
Tim, Tommy, and Tia find a lost toy and vow to return it to its owner.
When Gabby and Pandy turn tiny from one of MerCat's potions, they'll need to gather the right ingredients to help them grow back to their usual size.
When Spongey-Saurus gets wet, he grows; when he dries out, he shrinks; Gabby and Pandy must find a way to keep their new dino-pal the perfect size.

After chanting a spell to get in touch with her inner warrior, Blossom unknowingly takes Storm's warrior spirit; Gargamel casts a spell over Grouchy which makes everything that he complains about appear inside his hovel.
Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play, and build whatever the community needs.
When Mayor Humdinger transforms his robot cat Meow-Meow into a tiger-sized metal-eating menace, the PAW Patrol calls in the Cat Pack for help in the stopping the creature.
Liberty and the Poms team up with the Mighty Pups to save Adventure Bay from being crushed by a giant, flying Top Hat.
Ryder and the pups are on their way to the jungle to help Carlos move a relic to the museum, but Carlos falls into a pit. Carlos is then saved by a big-eared pup named Tracker.
Grandpa Pig needs help when his boat sinks, so Granddad Dog gives them all a lift to Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard so that the boat can be fixed.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her friends on a train ride where they must tick off what they see on their activity sheets.
Granny and her friends' historical re-enactment society are being cave people today. Peppa and George join in helping to catch Grandpa Pig who is dressed as a woolly mammoth.
Peppa and George discover frogs, worms and butterflies in Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's garden, and they play with them. Then Peppa, George and Grandpa have fun jumping in muddy puddles.
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and George are excited when Mr Zebra delivers a package from Aunt Dottie, who lives abroad, but they have different ideas about what they want to name their new toy.

Everyone is visiting snooty King and Queen Marigold's Castle. King and Queen Marigold give them a tour which features a room made of ice sculptures and an upside down room. However, the tour is not without a few mishaps.
Holly goes with Ben and Mr Elf to the elf farm to collect an egg for the King's breakfast. While there a huge chicken escapes from the farm and Holly and the elves have to chase it.
It is harvest day. The elves and fairies enlist the help of Mr Gnome in picking blackberries. If only they could stop him from eating them all.
Holly and Ben think Gaston the Ladybird is sad so they try and cheer him up by tidying his cave, but Gaston liked his cave just as it was, all messy and untidy.
Winnie Winnington goes looking for a frog to enter in a frog-jumping contest and ends up needing to be rescued in a swamp; the pups try to help salmon get to an ocean and also need to rescue Alex.
Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan shares some tales that speak to the soul.
Peppa and her friends and family are looking forward to a trip to the seaside where they can make sandcastles, but when they arrive at the beach there is too much snow.
Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children soon catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill?
Peppa and George are at the playground with their friends. Peppa loves to play on the swings, but George is a bit afraid of heights and doesn't like to be pushed too high.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful mini-golf course next door.
Peppa Pig and Suzy Sheep are spending the day with Doctor Hamster, and they are learning about what vets do. Doctor Hamster says she's glad to have two helpers with her and calls the next patient.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
Peppa and Suzy are excited about the sleepover and sit up in bed talking about what they will do when they grow up.
Holly invites Ben to the annual Royal Fairy Picnic. King Thistle hopes there won't be a repeat of last year's magical jelly flood.
Holly needs her wand to do magic, but one day Holly loses her wand, and is very sad.
Percy is tasked with finding the perfect image to put on a new Sodor stamp.
Diesel discovers just because rubbish is not seen, it does not mean it is not there.
Dora and Boots help Benny perfect a new move in time for the championship volleyball game. Dora and Boots show Dulce the dragon that everyone's differences are what make them excellent!
Tim and Dad have to catch a troublesome mole.
Tim, Tommy, Tia and Grandma go on the search for treasure.
Tim Rex tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim explores Rumbleton to find somewhere he can have fun alone.
Paddington and Robot Paddington enjoy being heroes, Paddington discovers how to be calm.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; the first stop is the biggest potato in the world; when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
King Thistle has a cold and needs some medicine. Nanny Plum, Holly, and Ben, have a lot of fun collecting the ingredients to make a magic potion to cure his cold and make him better.
King Thistle wants bread for his royal breakfast, but there isn't any flour in the castle. Mr Elf takes everyone to the Elf Windmill to find out why it takes so long to make flour.
Sadly, Peppa and her family's holiday in Australia is coming to an end, but they still have time to play with a boomerang and make friends with Mr Wallaby.

Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their favourite nursery rhymes. From singing Little Bo Peep to marching along with The Grand Old Duke of York, everyone enjoys listening to each other's choice.
Peppa's family are at Digger World, where they have fun building walls and knocking them over again, and even help Mr Bull when there's an obstacle in the road.
Teddy needs mending and cleaning after rolling down hills and jumping in muddy puddles, so Peppa takes her to Miss Rabbit's Doll Hospital.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; after a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds an art piece at Suzy's house.

It's World Book Day, and Paddington helps Mateo discover his favourite character. Paddington, Simi, and Jonathan are on a dinosaur hunt on the island in the park, but they are unsure if dinosaurs still exist.

When things go missing in Windsor Gardens, Jonathan believes a black hole is to blame, so Paddington goes on a space mission. Simi and Paddington try to find the gold at the end of the rainbow after they break Baaz's kaleidoscope.
Paddington builds a robot that he calls Paddington that requires a real friend to work, Baaz invites everyone to celebrate Diwali with him, and Paddington is his helpful assistant.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandma, Peppa and George go to the shed to see what Grandpa is doing and discover that he's built a robot.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when they learn that Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow are getting married the next day; everyone goes into a panic when they confess how they have done nothing to prepare for the big day.

Everyone prepares for Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow's wedding; Peppa and the soon-to-be-weds go to the jewellers to get rings, to the dressmakers, to get a wedding dress and finally to Peppa's house to sort the wedding cake.
The day of Mrs. Cow and Mr. Bull wedding arrives, but not everything goes to plan; nothing stops it being the best wedding ever and there is a lot of happy crying.
On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.
While at a playgroup with Madame Gazelle, Peppa and her friends learn all about the weather by building themselves a Weather Station, complete with thermometer, wind turbine and rain collector.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Daddy Pig suggests they ride imaginary bikes. Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.
Peppa and Suzy Sheep are best friends, but one day they have a quarrel over a game of cards and decide they are not best friends any more.
Peppa and George go to play with Cousin Chloe and her friends, but the older children don't want to play any baby games.
Pearl, the neighbourhood's best kicker, has albinism and nystagmus, so the teams use a Beep Kickball to play.
Redbeard the Elf Pirate sets sail to find the lost city, but soon finds himself in trouble and in need of rescuing.
The Wise Old Elf fears an alien invasion after a presumed shooting star lands in the Little Kingdom.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George to the playground, but does not understand the children's rules.

Madame Gazelle presents the poetry to Peppa and her friends, explaining that sounds can also be poems. When it starts raining, the inspired children create a beautiful poem about the rain and recite it to their parents.
Peppa is feeling unwell and Doctor Brown Bear says she must stay in bed. Peppa's friends come to cheer her up.

Peppa and George go bird watching with Grandpa Pig. Peppa quacks like a duck, George coos like a pigeon, and they all have great fun filling in Grandpa Pig's book. Grandpa wants to see a cuckoo, and suddenly he hears one calling.
Gabby and Pandy become knights in training and practise bravery by crossing a moat, mixing potions and more.
When Rainbow Puppy's piglet Twinkle goes missing, Josh plays Blue's Clues to find it.
The sudden wrapping up of Curry and Paddington's favourite radio show leaves many questions unanswered; Curry must learn to take orders as Paddington's butler for a day.
At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical Kiddie Workout.
Daddy Pig is looking forward to taking Peppa and George to visit a fishpond that he used to visit when he was a piglet. However, a few things have changed since then.
There's a spider in the house. Mummy Pig tells Daddy Pig to get rid of it. Mr Skinny-Legs is set free in the garden, where he can spin all the webs he likes.
Peppa and George are visiting their big cousin Chloe and will get to meet Chloe's new baby brother Alexander for the first time.
Pedro Pony pretends he is a proper cowboy, telling everyone stories in the camp he has set up in the garden.
Daddy Pig winds up the old cuckoo clock in Peppa and George's bedroom. When the clock strikes the hour, a wooden bird pops out, flapping its wings and singing 'Cuckoo'.
Wandy gets a cold and is taken ill, Holly is given a replacement wand. This new wand can do lots of things that Wandy can't, and soon becomes the favourite.
The children are playing a game of superheroes. When Strawberry takes her super villain role a bit too far, it is up to the 'Elf Man' and 'Fairy Girl' to save the day.
Ben, Holly and Nanny Plum help Mrs Witch have a bit of a clear-out. The children bring the magical items back home, but in the wrong hands, they cause a few problems.

Siblings Shovel and Pail can't agree on an ending for their storybook; when they get so upset that they stop talking to each other, it's up to Josh and Blue to figure out a way to get them to resolve the conflict.
Daddy Pig and Mr Bull are digging up the playground, so Daddy Pig decides to teach the kids some simple science. The first experiment is to see how many children it takes to pick up Madame Gazelle.
It's raining, and Peppa is sad because she cannot play outside. However, when the rain stops, Peppa and George get to play one of their favourite games, namely jumping in muddy puddles.
Peppa and George visit Granny Pig, who is very excited about her new pet, a parrot called Polly.
Mandy Mouse joins Peppa's playgroup. She uses a wheelchair and is super sporty. The children have a lot of fun playing together.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.

Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to school on their scooters. When he decides that it would be quicker to ride back, he discovers that riding scooters is great fun. Mummy Pig thinks that they are fun too and they both ride the scooters.
The bath tap at the Little Castle is dripping, so the elf plumber is called. It's a bigger job than first expected, but with King and Queen Marigolds coming round, there's not much time.
Granny Thistle comes to visit and gives Daisy and Poppy a powerful magical wand. The children escape from the castle and go bananas.
Mr Elf is overworked so King Thistle sentences him to a holiday. He isn't too pleased, but Mrs Elf and Ben are overjoyed! Meanwhile, Nanny takes over the food deliveries.
The Gabby Cats need to make a special art project for Baby Box's Meow-Seum Day; with many different ways to make art, who knows what they'll create.
Mrs Brown finds out what Paddington is good at in 'Paddington Finds a Hobby', then in 'Paddington and the Stamp', Paddington writes a letter to Aunt Lucy, and gets stuck in a post box.
Ben and Holly visit the beehive to see how honey is made. Wise Old Elf is the beekeeper, and he proceeds to show the children his special way of collecting honey.
When Captain Squid leaves his treasure map in the Little Kingdom, Redbeard the Elf Pirate leads Ben, Holly and Nanny Plum on a treasure hunt.
A magical card arrives in the Little Kingdom, inviting everyone to a party at Granny and Granpapa Thistle's castle in the clouds.
A cake sale is organised to mend the magic school, but Queen Thistle is baking and no one can eat her cakes.
Peppa and her friends go on a camping trip with their teacher, Madame Gazelle. After pitching their tents and collecting sticks, they all sing a song around the campfire.
Peppa's friend Pedro wears glasses, and Peppa thinks she might need them too, so Mummy Pig takes her to the optician.
Madame Gazelle takes the children to Grampy Rabbit's gym class, where they learn how to be real explorers.
Goldie the fish does not look happy and is not eating her food. Peppa, George, and Mummy Pig take her on a bus trip to visit Dr Hamster the vet.
Peppa and George learn some wonderful magic words. Nice things happen when they say please and thank you.
Peppa and George have fun in the snow, as they make footprints, snowballs and build a snowman.
Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the 'Super Potato' film.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.

Paddington helps to hatch an egg, but it takes ages, and when it finally cracks open, he gets a real surprise. Paddington wishes he could have been at Mr and Mrs Brown's wedding after seeing some photos, so they decide to do it all again.

Tracker has a dream that Mayor Humdinger turns into a baby. Now it's up to the pups to find the special coconut to reverse the spell. Alex is hosting a fun party in Adventure Bay but is heartbroken when his special piñata mysteriously disappears.
The pups must chase down Mayor Humdinger and the Kit-tastrophe Crew when they steal gold discovered in Adventure Bay. Mayor Humdinger orders the Kit-tastrophe Crew to steal the Paw Patroller.

Mummy Pig shows Peppa and her friend Suzy Sheep some old photographs from when they were babies. Peppa and Suzy don't remember being that young, but they are pleased to see that they have always been best friends.
Peppa's family is staying at Cousin Chloe's house. It's been a long day and everyone is tired and sleepy, but baby Alexander keeps everyone awake with his crying.

It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited. That can only mean one thing, soft play. George and friends have great fun, swinging, bouncing and climbing, but it isn't quite as much fun for the grown-ups.
Grandpa Pig pops round with some seeds for Peppa and George to plant, with Daddy Pig helping out by acting as a scarecrow.
Miss Rabbit gives Mummy Pig, Peppa and George a ride in her rescue helicopter. Daddy Pig is very sad to miss all the fun, but Miss Rabbit makes sure that doesn't happen.
Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground. Polly fetches Granny Pig and Grandad Dog to rescue them.
Gasquatch invites Blaze and AJ to his ice cream party, but forgets the ice cream. Blaze transforms into an ice cream truck and races to reach Gasquatch's house in time.
Paddington meets Mateo's dog, and Paddington delivers Love Day cards to his friends.
Peppa, George and Daddy are in the garden painting a picture of a cherry tree when the ducks turn up and run through the paint, and all over their masterpiece.
Suzy Sheep has come to play with Peppa, and has made up a pretend friend called 'Leo Lion'. Peppa can't see Leo, but Suzy announces that Leo likes roaring and playing dressing up.
Peppa and George explore the greenhouse, and it is full of lovely tomatoes and basil. When it is time for dinner, Granny Pig takes all the ingredients they have grown and makes a tasty salad.
Mummy Dog surprises Captain Daddy Dog with a gift of a boat trip for his birthday, but when Peppa and the gang come along, the trip doesn't go to plan.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.

Peppa and George love jumping in muddy puddles, even when it's raining, but when George takes off his rain hat he catches a cold. After plenty of rest and some warm milk and honey, George begins to feel much better.
It's Wendy Wolf's birthday, and she has invited Peppa and all her friends to her party. There are bubbles and balloons to play with, and Wendy even teaches them how to howl like a wolf.

Grandpa and Granny Pig take Peppa, George and all their friends on a boat trip to Pirate Island. On the island, Grandpa shows everyone how to use his metal detector to find treasure, and they all build a big sandcastle.
Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office and meet his colleagues. Mr Rabbit works with numbers, while Mrs Cat seems to spend her time drawing shapes on a computer.
Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail.
Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. George is a little worried at first but is soon splashing happily with his friend Richard Rabbit.
Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa and each of her friends bring in an old toy.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it starts to get foggy, and before long it becomes so foggy that they can't see anything.
Peppa's car runs out of petrol, but Granddad Dog's garage is nearby, and with one call, Granddad Dog is on his way to help.
Peppa and George help Mummy Pig tidy up the breakfast things. Mummy Pig teaches them how to recycle the bottles and newspapers, then they take everything to Miss Rabbit at the recycling plant.
Peppa and George go to the seaside with Granny and Grandpa Pig and realise not all beaches are sandy. This one has lots of rocks and little rock pools to explore.
Madame Gazelle takes the class to London for the day, where they are given a tour of the city by none other than the Queen of England.

The Browns meet Shantee the lighthouse keeper when they arrive at the beach for their holiday. Paddington, Jonathan, and Judy become trainee lifeguards and end up rescuing Mr Brown with Taylor the lifeguard's help.

Something is making the strange noises in the cave. Jonathan thinks it's a mermaid, but Paddington isn't so sure. Judy wants to find a fossil on the beach, but everyone else seems to be getting lucky except her. Paddington tries to help.

Weil Patrick sich als Wurm ausgibt, kommt er ins Tierheim und kann nur raus, wenn SpongeBob ihn richtig erziehen kann. Nachdem die Band vom 1000-Taubenüsschen-Nusseis-Partyboot gefeuert wird, versuchen SpongeBob und Patrick sie wieder zu vereinen.

Zwei bekannte Gesichter aus SpongeBobs Vergangenheit kommen nach Bikini Bottom auf einen Besuch vorbei. Jedoch ahnt niemand, dass die beiden ein großes Problem mitbringen. Außerdem findet Plankton in der Kanalisation einen ungewöhnlichen Verbündeten.
SpongeBob und seine Freunde reisen zum Nordpol, um dem Weihnachtsmann ein Geschenk zu geben.
Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Fantasy, Entertainment

Die neue Vertretungslehrerin von Mrs. Puff gibt SpongeBob einen Crashkurs im Autofahren. Als Mr. Krabs und Plankton eine Quelle mit Wunderfett unter ihren Restaurants entdecken, müssen die beiden sich zusammenschließen und zusammenarbeiten.

Karen erzählt von der Geschichte eines Strebers, der versucht, eine Actionfigur von seinen drei kleinen Nachbarn zu stehlen. Währenddessen ist Thaddäus damit beschäftigt, einen "Wir Hassen SpongeBob"-Klub zu veranstalten.

SpongeBob und Thaddäus versuchen die Krabbenburger aus einem Imbisswagen heraus in den dunkelsten Tiefen des Ozeans zu verkaufen. Währenddessen verbringen Pearl und Narlene Zeit in der Großstadt zur Feier des Tags des Wals.

Plankton baut einen Roboter, der jeden bestraft, der "Aww" sagt, da er nur als niedlich gesehen wird und nicht als böse. Nachdem Patrick den Postboten zerquetscht, müssen er und SpongeBob die Post in Bikini Bottom austragen.

1. Geschichte: Perla will so cool sein wie ihre Freundinnen und sucht sich deshalb einen Job in der Mall. Leider ist nur in dem lahmsten Geschäft des Einkaufszentrums eine Stelle für sie frei! 2. Geschichte: SpongeBob kann seinen Daumen nicht mehr verwenden und eine Welt bricht für ihn zusammen.

1. Geschichte: SpongeBob muss es mit den härtesten Jungs der Unterwasserstadt, den Sharks aufnehmen. 2. Geschichte: Plankton hat einen fiesen Plan: Um an die Geheimformel zu kommen, klont er SpongeBob! Doch das Original kommt ihm in die Quere.

Mr. Krabs möchte gerne mit seinem Geld sprechen können und verkauft dafür seine Seele. Thaddäus will SpongeBob durch eine Burgerbratmaschine ersetzen, das kann der nicht auf sich sitzen lassen. Thaddäus will einen Tanzwettbewerb gewinnen.

SpongeBob ist ein Star, denn er wurde von einem berühmten Restaurantkritiker positiv bewertet. Patrick liest eine Anzeige von einer Plattenfirma und will sofort selbst ein Lied machen. Er schickt sein Gedicht hin und bald hört man sein Lied überall.

Sandy hat einen Floh aus Texas in Bikini Bottom eingeschleppt, der Chaos auslöst. Patrick findet einen Donut und weiß nicht, ob er ihn essen kann. SpongeBob bekommt Ärger mit Mr. Krabs, weil auf einem Teller noch ein Schmutzfleck ist.

Plankton hat ein Gas hergestellt, das aus Erwachsenen Babys macht und probiert es an Mr. Krabs. Ein Gourmet-Koch kommt zu Besuch in die Krosse Krabbe, während SpongeBob in einem Nobelhotel kochen soll. Aber das ist nicht so leicht.

SpongeBob hat sich schick angezogen, denn es ist Fototag, aber es ist schwer, sauber zu bleiben. Patrick hat einen Haufen Krabbenburger gegessen, aber er kann nicht bezahlen. SpongeBob muss aufpassen, dass Blackjack nicht seine Familie belästigt.

SpongeBob hat sich aus Versehen selbst ein blaues Auge verpasst, was ihm sehr peinlich ist. Er denkt sich also eine Geschichte aus. Plankton ist neidisch auf den Erfolg von Mr. Krabs und will deswegen gegen ihn in den Kampf ziehen.

SpongeBob ist gestresst und vergisst bei der Zubereitung der Krabben-Pizza die wichtigsten Zutaten. Seine Freunde befürchten, dass er eventuell unter Gedächtnisverlust leidet. SpongeBob ist das so peinlich, dass er sich am liebsten verkriechen würde.
Blaze wird zu einem Schnellzug und nimmt am Großen Zug-Rennen teil. Kann Blaze gewinnen?

Dora und Boots begeben sich mit Backpack auf die Suche nach ihrem verschwundenen Anhänger. Zudem steht eine Pyjamaparty an, für die Boots seine Bananen-Decke dringend benötigt. Dora hilft ihm, das geliebte Stück rechtzeitig wiederzufinden.
Die Dinghy-Hütte beherbergt Übernachtungscamps außerhalb des Wassers.
Weil Patrick in der Handschuhwelt einen Roboter beschädigt, kommen er und SpongeBob ins Gefängnis. Es kommt zu einer chaotischen Flucht.
Das Team der Krossen Krabbe versucht Krabbenburger auf den Tribünen eines Konzerts zu verkaufen.

Will und Min helfen Jack bei der Suche nach einer guten Geschichte. Lily verschüttet Bubbletea in Jacks Koffer und will ihre Spuren verwischen. Lily zeigt Jack, wie man einen perfekten Sommertag in Canyon Valley verbringt.

Die Familie will in einem Asia-Laden einen seltenen Keks ergattern. Jack ist glücklich, denn nun fühlt er sich als Teil der Familie. Nach einer schlechten Bewertung des Tierpflegesalons will Lily unbedingt den Schuldigen finden.

Nachdem die Wohnung zufriert, nimmt Lou an der Vermieterkonferenz teil und Papier will alle retten. In einem Prank-Battle stellen sich Schere, Stein und Papier gegen die Ratten-Bros und Bleistift. Doch Bleistift hat eine geheime Waffe.
Das Trio macht sich gemeinsam auf den Weg, um sieben Limetten von Pipers Schwester zu bekommen.

Lincoln Loud ist der einzige Junge und das mittlere Kind in einer elfköpfigen Familie. Er lebt in der kleinen Stadt Royal Woods, Michigan, und hat zehn Schwestern mit unterschiedlichen Persönlichkeiten. Lori, die Älteste, ist herrisch, Lucy ist gegen alles, und Luan ist immer für einen Scherz zu haben. Lincoln erlebt das Abenteuer seines Lebens, als er die ganze Familie nach Schottland mitnimmt und herausfindet, dass sie Nachkommen der dortigen Königsfamilie sind.

1. Geschichte: Lori hat sich dazu entschlossen, im Restaurant ihres Vaters als Kellnerin auszuhelfen. Der Job stellt sich jedoch als schwieriger raus als von ihr erwartet. 2. Geschichte: Lana will mit ihrem Hund Charles an einer Hundeshow teilnehmen und versucht ihn zu trainieren.
Lisa schickt Todd zu Darcys Geburtstagsparty, weil sie an diesem Tag eine Vorlesung hat.

Kurz entschlossen eröffnet SpongeBob einen Seifenblasenstand. Patrick erlebt als erster Kunde eine herbe Enttäuschung: Seifenblasen machen ist gar nicht so einfach. Aber kein Problem: SpongeBob bietet jetzt auch noch Anfängerkurse im Seifenblasen an.

Sandy hat den Blues und SpongeBob ist entschlossen herauszufinden, warum und was er dagegen tun kann. Die Heilung erweist sich als etwas schwieriger als erwartet, als sich herausstellt, dass Sandy Heimweh nach dem guten alten Texas hat.

Patrick und SpongeBob lieben das Quallenfischen. Thaddäus kann diese Leidenschaft nicht teilen. Als er jedoch nach einem Fahrradunfall im Rollstuhl sitzt, kann er sich den Aufmerksamkeiten der beiden passionierten Hobbyfischer nicht mehr erwehren.
Thaddäus und Blubberbernd sind gezwungen, auf einer Reise nach Jetsam City miteinander auszukommen.

Sandy gibt ihre Raupe bei SpongeBob und Patrick in Pflege, da sie ein paar Tage verreist. Über Nacht wird aus der kleinen Raupe ein Schmetterling und die beiden glauben, dass dieser die Raupe gefressen hat. Schnell warnen sie alle Meeresbewohner.

Mr. Krabs, SpongeBob, Patrick und Thaddäus werden von einer riesigen Welle erfasst. Alle werden in eine andere Ecke gespült. Mr. Krabs landet im Holländer-Dreieck, von dem man nicht so leicht fliehen kann. Er braucht die Hilfe der Freunde.
SpongeBob feiert den Jahrestag der Freundschaft mit Thaddäus; Thaddäus muss zur Musikstunde.

Chloe muss zur Sommerschule, wo sie von Max unterrichtet wird. Währenddessen erledigt Phoebe Missionen im Alleingang und trifft dabei einen neuen Superhelden, Captain Perfect. Sie stellen fest, dass sie im Kampf gegen das Böse ein tolles Team sind.

Max will das Geheimnis von Captain Perfect lüften, nachdem er von dessen Zusammenarbeit mit Phoebe erfährt. Währenddessen lädt BC, Chloe's Schwarm, sie zu einer Produktparty ein. Jinx und Booch sind dagegen und protestieren gegen die Veranstaltung.

Papier befürchtet, dass Bleistift zu viel Angst haben wird, wenn sie einen Horrorfilm anschauen. Stein und Schere müssen Papier schnell helfen, denn ein leichter Wind weht und Papier ist noch auf der Straße. Die beiden müssen ihn retten.

Ein hartnäckiger Geist weigert sich in die Kamera zu lächeln und ruiniert das Bild des Trios. Um Respekt von anderen zu erlangen, gibt Papier sich als Arzt aus. Aus dem Grund verkleidet sich Schere als Basketballstar und will ihn damit übertrumpfen.
Patrick leitet eine Country-Style-Show. Die Seetang-Beet-Kinder reisen in die Zukunft.

Babs kann nach einem Besuch beim Augenarzt vorübergehend nicht sehen. Pinky will ihr helfen und bietet sich bereitwillig als Blinden-Hotdog an. Als Pinky versehentlich die Lampe seiner Mutter kaputtmacht, gibt er sich selbst Hausarrest.

Luna muss ihren schrecklichen Husten loswerden, bevor sie bei dem großen Rockwettbewerb teilnehmen kann. Der Morticians-Klub will Bertrand dabei helfen, von dem Kreuzfahrtschiff zu entkommen, auf dem seine Eltern beide arbeiten.

Lynn betrachtet die Cheerleader nicht als Athleten und tut sie ab. Daraufhin werden sie und ihre Teamkollegen zu einem Wettkampf herausgefordert. Außerdem wird Lori in der Schule berühmt, nachdem sie einen Hole-in-One geschlagen hat.

Weil Lisa und Todd von Lenis aufdringlichem Babysitten genervt sind, schießen sich die beiden aus Versehen ins Weltall. Um bei dem Mutter-Tochter-Wettbewerb mitmachen zu können, versucht Lola, ihre Mutter in Topform zu bringen.

Durch das Verschwinden aller Byjovianer stehen die Halbritter vor einer Niederlage. Torin versucht sie einzusperren, aber dank der Hilfe von Bruce werden sie gerettet. Max erfährt, dass es vielleicht einen Weg gibt, ihre Liebsten zu retten.
SpongeBob verzweifelt, als er versehentlich unter seinem Trainingsgerät eingeklemmt wird.

Helga hat ein wichtiges Medaillon direkt vor Arnolds Haus verloren. Es enthält das Bild von Arnold. Außerdem hat Sid ein Problem. Er will sich ab sofort von seinem Lieblingsfrosch fernhalten, da auf diesem zu viele Bakterien lauern.

Arnold trifft Helga beim Baseball versehentlich am Kopf, woraufhin sie ihr Gedächtnis verliert. Arnold kümmert sich natürlich um die Verletzte, die davon gar nicht genug bekommen kann. Opa möchte mit Jimmy am Ironman-Triathlon teilnehmen.

Da er Schule für dumm und überflüssig hält, entscheidet Arnold, nicht mehr hinzugehen. Aber schon nach zwei Tagen wird ihm langweilig. Ernie ist in ein Model verliebt. Es kommt sogar zu einem Date, aber mehr möchte die Schönheit danach nicht.
When a dangerous piñata ends up at a kid's birthday party, Kid Danger and Captain Man must go undercover and step in before it's too late.
When Captain Man suddenly announces he's getting married, Henry and Charlotte go searching for answers only to discover that things are not as they seem.

Max and Phoebe secretly employ their parents' former sidekick to ease their busy schedule. However, the twins' bickering and inability to share provokes an unexpected response from their new sidekick.
After Phoebe chooses Billy to accompany her to their favourite cookie factory's exclusive tasting event, Max and Nora are determined to sneak in and get to the delicious treats first.
The gang set out to find Spencer friends his own age. They eventually find some decent candidates, but will friendship bloom?
When Sam's laptop gets stolen, the iCarly gang tries to help track down the thief. Meanwhile, Spencer can't visit his favourite arcade unless he's accompanied by a child.

Jade helps Mica, Suzanne and Bibi, but quickly becomes overwhelmed and struggles to prevent chaos at Chahuta. The Marsupilamis miss the delivery man and chase after him to retrieve an important package.
Jokey has a new prank: giving Grouchy a potion that makes him say okey-dokey to every request.
Rowena enchants Voltaire, compelling his obedience; Jokey's prank backfires, resulting in all Smurfs being transformed into pebbles.
Doctor Brainy & Mister Dumb: Brainy's new brain-weighing invention backfires and leaves him brainless.
Clumsy and Dimwitty want to help Rowena cure her plant, but little do they know it's all a scam to capture Smurfs; Rowena turns Vanity and Storm into dolls.
SpongeBob and Patrick exchange tiny living versions of themselves in 'Fun-Sized Friends', then in 'Grandmum's the Word', Plankton tells his Grandma that he owns the Krusty Krab!
SpongeBob and Patrick become trapped in an alternate dimension where anything they draw comes to life. SpongeBob and Patrick help Bubble Bass move out of his mother's basement.
